snippet.description:
Feeling Lost in Your Prep? You Don't Need Another Lecture or Book. You need a Mentor to help you build the right strategy for you. 

Yes, you can still make significant progress — but you need a clear strategy, the right priorities and a personalised plan.

Sonia Ma’am, Head of Mentorship at LevelUp IAS, invites you to our Offline Meetup where you can meet the LevelUp Mentorship Team, discuss your preparation, clear your doubts and get 1-on-1 guidance for:

→ UPSC Mains
→ Prelims
→ Your Mains strategy after Prelims

📍 LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre
📅 20 September 2026
⏰ 2 PM – 5 PM

Open for everyone.

Walk in with your doubts.
Walk out with more clarity.
